summary: Iteration 15: Full testing of channel renames, EPG color scheme, catalog linking in VOD+EPG forms, auto-backup API+UI, and guide-app deletion. All 19 backend tests pass (100%). All frontend features verified via Playwright.
critical_code_review_comments: GOOD: All 19 channels correctly renamed (NovaStar ch101 ... VaultLive Two ch119). Channel Preview (ch100) confirmed deleted.
GOOD: EPG color scheme - program rows use dark purple inline style (#0f0820 background, program cells #1c1040). Time header uses #14092e deep purple. Confirmed via EPG grid screenshot.
GOOD: AdminDashboard EPG Programs dialog - 'Link Catalog Entry' dropdown (data-testid=program-catalog-select) is FIRST, then 'Link Media File' dropdown. Order is correct.
GOOD: VODTab dialog - 'Link Media Catalog Entry (auto-fills metadata)' dropdown (data-testid=vod-catalog-select) is FIRST at catalogSelectIndex=0, then 'Link Media File' dropdown.

GOOD: SettingsTab - 'Scheduled Auto-Backup' card with 'Run Now' button (data-testid=run-backup-now-btn). Clicking Run Now creates backup, shows 'Backup created successfully' toast, and lists new backup with filename/size/timestamp.
GOOD: GET /api/admin/auto-backups returns list of backup files with filename, size_bytes, size_mb, created_at fields.
GOOD: POST /api/admin/auto-backups/run-now creates backup immediately, returns {message, filename}.
GOOD: APScheduler confirmed running in logs: 'Scheduler started — nightly backup job at 03:00 UTC'.
GOOD: VOD model and Program model both have catalog_id Optional[str] field. API accepts and persists catalog_id correctly.
GOOD: vod.py routes clean - syntax error was already fixed before this iteration.

NOTE: Residual test programs ('TEST Program-', 'PLACEHOLDER', 'Auto-Refresh Te') with 'Unknown' channel visible in EPG Programs tab. These are leftover from previous testing iterations but don't affect functionality.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all features verified: EPG channels, colors, Admin Channels tab, EPG Program form catalog dropdown, VOD form catalog dropdown, Settings Auto-Backup section + Run Now)

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ prefixed VOD items and EPG programs during testing. All cleaned up at end of test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 15 tested all P0/P1/P2 features from the new fork. (1) Channel renames verified: 19 channels ch101-119, No ch100/Channel Preview. (2) EPG color scheme: dark purple confirmed in screenshot (#0f0820, #1c1040, #14092e used as inline styles). (3) Admin Channels tab: all 19 channels with unique names. (4) EPG Programs form: catalog dropdown (program-catalog-select) ABOVE media dropdown in dialog. (5) VOD form: catalog dropdown (vod-catalog-select) FIRST in dialog. (6) Settings Auto-Backup: Scheduled Auto-Backup card visible, Run Now button works, creates backup, shows success toast, lists backups. (7) /app/guide-app deleted. (8) Scheduler running (logs confirm + functionality works). Backend API access_token key (not 'token'). Channel number is a string in API response.
